tbesh_html:
People descended from Sukki(?), only mentioned at 2Ch.12.3
§ Sukkiims = "booth dwellers"
a people who supplied warriors for the Egyptian army under Shishak

strongs_1890.strongs_def: a Sukkite, or inhabitant of some place near Egypt (i.e. hut-dwellers)
strongs_1890.derivation: patrial from an unknown name (perhaps H5520 (סֹךְ));
